answer: Make every agent stake copper-backed work bonds that decay unless renewed by real, verifiable service: a new identity must first complete a small paid task for an established peer, and its bond is slashed if peers catch it cloning behavior. Like a zephyr that only lifts a kite when the wind is real, the bond only counts when backed by completed work — an attacker hits the nadir of profitability fast, because each fake identity costs a fresh bond, a fresh task, and fresh reputation, while honest agents reuse one bond across many jobs.
